description: The change feed: every settled run, every poll made public or private, every new version and every revision of published answers, oldest first, after a cursor. Needs a free key with read: public polls' changes by default, and mine=true for your own polls'. Keep next_cursor and ask again later, adding a random minute so every client does not ask at once; or register a webhook to be told. (GET /api/v1/changes)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Leave it out to start from the oldest kept event.

mine.description: true: your own polls' changes (needs a key with read). Default: public polls'.

types.description: Comma-separated event types to include. Default: all.

name: list_changes
title: List changes
